description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans.Journaling project, specifically testing the integration and behavior of LogSegment implementations with Azure Storage Blob and in-memory storage backends. It includes test classes for Azure storage-based log segments and in-memory log segments, as well as a base class with comprehensive test methods for validating list operations, persistence, recovery, and complex object handling within the storage backends.

classes.name: AzureStorageLogSegmentTests
classes.description: Test class for Azure Blob Storage-based log segment, inherits from LogSegmentTests, sets up Azure storage options.

classes.name: InMemoryLogSegmentTests
classes.description: Test class for in-memory log segment, inherits from LogSegmentTests, uses in-memory storage provider.

classes.name: LogSegmentTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing a suite of tests for implementations of IStateMachineStorageProvider, including list operations, persistence, recovery, and complex object handling.

classes.name: TestPerson
classes.description: Serializable record used in tests involving complex object storage and retrieval.

classes.name: TestGrainContext
classes.description: Mock implementation of IGrainContext used to provide context for storage operations during tests.

methods.name: AzureStorageLogSegmentTests
methods.description: Constructor that checks preconditions for Azure storage tests.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Method to configure dependency injection services for Azure storage log segment tests.

methods.name: InMemoryLogSegmentTests
methods.description: Method to configure services for in-memory storage tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up dependency injection, and starts the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: CreateTestComponents
methods.description: Creates and initializes the components needed for a specific list test, including storage, manager, and list instances.

methods.name: DurableList_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic add, update, and remove operations on the list.

methods.name: DurableList_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that list state persists across different instances.

methods.name: DurableList_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving complex objects with mutable properties.

methods.name: DurableList_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the Clear operation and its persistence.

methods.name: DurableList_Contains_Test
methods.description: Tests the Contains and Remove methods.

methods.name: DurableList_LargeNumberOfOperations_And_Snapshot_Test
methods.description: Performs stress testing with many operations and recovery, including snapshotting behavior.
